trials.claim: Transform default WooCommerce pages with drag-and-drop builder for Elementor and Gutenberg
trials.claimQuote: Transform default WooCommerce pages with a drag-and-drop page builder for Elementor and Gutenberg
trials.reasoning: Reviewers confirm page-builder functionality for product, cart, checkout and account pages and easy Elementor use for WooCommerce stores. The complaint about only the add-to-cart button does not materially undercut that broader support.

exhibits.quote: But for now, it's impossible to really customize "add to cart" button, such a shame, hope this feature will be improve very soon.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports a core WooCommerce element cannot really be customized, undermining the transform-any-page builder claim.

exhibits.quote: Love the design and functionality of the product because it offers the same functionality of a page builder for my products, cart, checkout, and my account pages.
exhibits.argument: The reviewer confirms the product provides page-builder functionality for core WooCommerce pages like products, cart and checkout.

exhibits.quote: as the name woolentor its really true the best plugin will ever help you to create amazing woocommerce stores and enjoy the easy use of elementor on one place
exhibits.argument: The reviewer confirms the plugin is used to create WooCommerce stores with easy use of Elementor.

trials.claim: Lets you design shop, product, cart and checkout pages with no coding required
trials.claimQuote: ShopLentor lets you design shop, product, cart, and checkout pages in Elementor or Gutenberg—no coding required.
trials.reasoning: Reviewers confirm creating a store quickly without being a programmer and making a custom store layout as wanted. The add-to-cart button complaint is a narrow limitation, not evidence that coding is generally required.

exhibits.quote: But for now, it's impossible to really customize "add to cart" button, such a shame, hope this feature will be improve very soon.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports inability to customize the add-to-cart button without improvement, undermining no-coding design of product pages.

exhibits.quote: it is the best plugin to quickly create a store in woocommerce it is the best .. easy and fast and without the need to be a programmer has many options.
exhibits.argument: The reviewer confirms a store can be created quickly without needing to be a programmer.

exhibits.quote: I can create a custom layout for the store and make it look how I want.
exhibits.argument: The reviewer confirms the ability to create a custom layout for the store.

trials.claim: Create custom WooCommerce pages with templates, grids, wishlists, compare and currency switcher
trials.claimQuote: Create custom WooCommerce pages with templates, product grids, wishlists, compare, and a currency switcher
trials.reasoning: A buyer says a Product Loop for custom archives, categories and related product cards is missing, and another says premade blocks are largely similar. This materially limits the claimed custom pages, grids and templates, despite praise for some templates.

exhibits.quote: I'd also wish a Product Loop would be included so we can create and customise our own archives, categories and related product cards.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports Product Loop for custom archives and product cards is missing, undermining product grids claim.

exhibits.quote: Also, premade blocks are quite all similar in each category.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports templates lack style diversity, undermining templates claim.

exhibits.quote: The main product WooLentor is very very useful and comes with superb templates.
exhibits.argument: The reviewer confirms the product comes with superb templates for WooCommerce use.

exhibits.quote: Custom templates, the suggest a price widget, and the Sticky Add to Cart widget is just what the doctor ordered.
exhibits.argument: The reviewer confirms the availability of custom templates and widgets for WooCommerce.
